$comment: Phone first-load script budgets in KB gzipped, checked by scripts/check-script-budget.mjs after the production build. Set on 16 October 2026 at the measured size plus about 10 KB, and lowered the same day after the rail and search left a phone's first load. Lower a budget when a route shrinks. Raise one only with a reason in the PR. 18 October 2026 (PR #404, owner approval via Grok Bot 17:06 AWST): Home 560 to 563, Referrals 577 to 580 and ED 532 to 535 KB. The stricter executive count-only field lists and the downtime-pack context add about 2-2.5 KB gzipped to the shell every route loads, and main was already at these budgets. 18 October 2026 (PR #412, repo clean-up item 24): Ward 587 to 588 KB. Splitting the oversized ward screen into smaller files means its many values are now passed between components by name, which minifying cannot shorten; measured on this branch at 587.5 KB against main's 586.8 KB. The pieces that the React Compiler started memoising after the split are opted out with "use no memo", so the other routes stay within budget. 19 October 2026 (PR #419, owner approval): Home 563 to 564, Referrals 580 to 581, Ward 588 to 589 and Movements 623 to 624 KB. ED stays at 535. 19 October 2026 (PR #437, owner approval 17:24 UTC): Referrals 581 to 582 KB.
